### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Do not infer specific medical syndromes or advanced diagnoses (e.g., ARDS) from general symptoms or broader conditions; only include diagnoses explicitly stated or confirmed by the provider.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Report symptom characteristics (e.g., duration, constancy, frequency) only for the specific symptom mentioned and only if explicitly stated by the patient. Avoid generalization or inference of duration.
[A-Section]: When detailing the rationale for diagnoses or suspicions, strictly adhere to the explicit reasoning provided by the doctor; do not introduce external context or common knowledge as justification.
[P-Section]: Clearly distinguish between immediate treatment plans/reasons for admission and post-discharge instructions. Ensure the rationale for each plan item is explicitly stated and correctly attributed to its timing.
